requires_missing_evidence.title: 需要額外資料

completed_journey_or_incident_record.extra_data_needed: completed journey log、warnings/events timeline、trajectory/corridor diff、incident package candidates、post-trip review notes
completed_journey_or_incident_record.label: 完成旅程/事故紀錄

equipment_inventory_or_battery_telemetry.extra_data_needed: phone/watch/headlamp/powerbank battery、offline map state、food/water/fuel inventory、expected remaining time
equipment_inventory_or_battery_telemetry.label: 裝備/電量/資源 telemetry

gnss_accuracy.extra_data_needed: HDOP/VDOP、horizontal accuracy、fix type、satellite/C/N0 或 provider confidence
gnss_accuracy.label: GNSS 精度

gps_ins_dr_estimates_or_sensor_vitals_re.extra_data_needed: GPS-only trajectory、INS/DR/PDR estimates、raw IMU/PDR/vitals records、trajectory-diff metrics
gps_ins_dr_estimates_or_sensor_vitals_re.label: GPS/INS/DR 軌跡與 sensor records

incident_context_or_authorization_ref.extra_data_needed: injury/lost/incident context、emergency playbook context、operator/留守 authorization ref before outbound action
incident_context_or_authorization_ref.label: 事故情境與授權

review_queue_or_provenance_report.extra_data_needed: source provenance、review queue、conflict report、unanswered context requirements
review_queue_or_provenance_report.label: Review/provenance/conflict report

runtime_ingress_router_trace.extra_data_needed: transport ingress records、parser output、router decisions、filter handoff、timestamps、latency/loss counters
runtime_ingress_router_trace.label: Runtime ingress/router trace

safety_candidate_or_admission_state.extra_data_needed: risk candidate status、admission decision、persistence state、operator review、no-mutation proof
safety_candidate_or_admission_state.label: Safety candidate/admission state

team_member_positions_and_last_heard.extra_data_needed: team member positions、last-heard timestamps、check-in schedule、rendezvous plan、comms state
team_member_positions_and_last_heard.label: 隊伍位置與最後回報

tool_specific_evidence_not_verified.extra_data_needed: domain-specific source package 或 tool input contract 必須先定義並填入
tool_specific_evidence_not_verified.label: 工具專屬 evidence 尚未驗證

user_or_team_baseline_profile.extra_data_needed: fitness baseline、expected pace、load、acclimatization、skill level、水/補給計畫、risk tolerance
user_or_team_baseline_profile.label: 個人/隊伍 baseline profile

wearable_vitals_and_baseline.extra_data_needed: heart rate、HRV/body battery/source values、activity/pace trend、baseline-relative thresholds、privacy scope
wearable_vitals_and_baseline.label: 穿戴式生命徵象與 baseline
